name: True Mirage Weaver

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Shimmering Veil
traits.details: The weaver has concealment against enemies outside the aura. If the weaver takes radiant damage, this aura is deactivated until the start of the weaver’s next turn.

auras.name: Shimmering Veil
auras.details: The weaver has concealment against enemies outside the aura. If the weaver takes radiant damage, this aura is deactivated until the start of the weaver’s next turn.

hit.description: psychic damage, and the target is blinded (save ends).

powers.name: Defiling Strike
powers.trigger: The weaver hits with ashen bolt.

effect.description: The target also takes ongoing 10 necrotic damage (save ends), and the ground in a close burst 1 centered on the weaver becomes black sand.

powers.name: Mirage
powers.trigger: The weaver is hit by an attack.

effect.description: The weaver teleports up to 5 squares, and it becomes invisible until the end of its next turn or until it hits or misses with an attack. An illusion of the weaver appears in the square the weaver left. The illusion has the weaver’s defenses and shimmering veil, but it can take no actions and disappears if hit by an enemy attack power.
